author: Animalogic
description:
Think humans are the only ones with complex language, deep grief, or total genius? Think again. From wild cats that impersonate monkey babies to trick their prey, to crows that pass tests meant for human toddlers, and a bird that literally sleeps while flying tens of thousands of kilometers, these creatures are playing by a completely different set of rules.

01:09:09 The Bizarre Evolution of How We Draw Spinosaurus
01:36:50 Leonardo: Inside the Best-Preserved Dinosaur Mummy
02:08:11 What Science Got Wrong About the Largest Flying Animal
02:20:11 How Movies Lied to You About Velociraptors
